text:
Soooo..... I built this.

And it's already saving me ~4-6 hours/week.

When we receive a support ticket...
 
→ An agent (codex) is booted up

→ The agent reads our docs on @ferndeskhq, our codebase, our logs on @axiomhq and customer error.

→ If it's a bug, the agent does a root cause analysis and opens a PR + @linear ticket!

→ If it's a feature request, it tracks it on our feedback board.

→ It then, drafts a reply to the customer in my own voice  + includes customer success tips.

→ and then creates a handover for me with a note in our support tool (@getfernand)

Now all I need to do every morning is approve, approve approve, reject, approve.

And @ferndeskhq analyzes replies every week and updates our docs so that we get fewer tickets ongoing!

Can't believe this is now possible!!
